title: Welcome, Commander
speaker: nova
dialogue: I am NOVA, your onboard computer. This roster is our first link to the people who will fly with you.
task: Inspect one candidate and one attribute in the crew roster.

title: Access the Database
speaker: morgan
dialogue: Before we assign a single seat, I want to see the complete flight roster.
task: Display all columns and records from the astronauts table.
hints: Read the entire roster, including every attribute.

title: Know Your Candidates
speaker: nova
dialogue: The flight badges have room for two fields. Send me a name and a role for each candidate.
task: Display the name and role of every astronaut, in that column order.
hints: Choose just the two fields that fit on a badge.

title: Available Specialists
speaker: morgan
dialogue: Which specialties can this mission draw on? One entry per profession will do.
task: Display all unique astronaut roles. Use DISTINCT.
hints: Choose role alone, then remove duplicate results.

title: Finding an Engineer
speaker: chen
dialogue: The survey lander needs someone who can rebuild a power bus in gloves. Pull up our engineers.
task: Find all astronauts whose role is Engineer. Return every column.
hints: Filter the role column using an exact text value.

title: Experienced Astronauts
speaker: morgan
dialogue: Outpost Nine stopped transmitting mid-shift. We need people who can recognise trouble early.
task: Find all astronauts with at least 8 years of experience. Return every column.
hints: Someone with exactly eight years qualifies.

title: The Perfect Candidate
speaker: chen
dialogue: An experienced engineer on another assignment cannot fly with us. Check all three criteria.
task: Find available engineers with at least 5 years of experience. Return every column.
solution:
SELECT * FROM astronauts
WHERE role = 'Engineer'
  AND experience >= 5
  AND available = TRUE;
hints: Require the correct role, experience and availability simultaneously.

SELECT * FROM astronauts
WHERE role = 'Engineer'
  AND experience >= 5
  AND available = TRUE;

title: Scientific Expertise
speaker: reyes
dialogue: We will need two kinds of expertise on the surface. Show me everyone from science or medicine.
task: Find all astronauts who are scientists or doctors. Return every column.
hints: Each person has one role. Either of the two requested roles qualifies.

title: Medical Clearance
speaker: nova
dialogue: Medical review is still open for some candidates. Exclude their files from this transmission.
task: Find all astronauts whose medical status is not pending. Return every column.
hints: Reverse the condition that identifies a pending file.

title: Assemble Your Crew
speaker: morgan
dialogue: The manifest is yours, Commander. Give me the qualified candidates and we will assign four flight seats.
task: Display the names and roles of available, medically cleared astronauts with at least 6 years of experience.
solution:
SELECT name, role FROM astronauts
WHERE available = TRUE
  AND medical_status = 'cleared'
  AND experience >= 6;
hints: First choose the two requested columns. Then test three flight requirements.
WHERE available AND medical_status = … AND experience >= …

SELECT name, role FROM astronauts
WHERE available = TRUE
  AND medical_status = 'cleared'
  AND experience >= 6;
